rationale: CRISPR knockout screen (sgRNAs against ~1,900 genes at breast-cancer GWAS/TWAS risk loci plus immune controls, 5 guides per gene, 737 non-targeting and 262 AAVS1 guides) in MCF7 cells co-cultured for the last days with HLA-matched cytotoxic T cells. GEO holds MAGeCK-normalized guide tables; raw reads were recovered exactly (100% integral, one scale per column) by prepare.R with tools/screen-reanalysis/recover_counts.R. GSM 'Library name' fields map to count columns (D11 = HER2_WS_7/11/15, D11+T = HER2_WS_9/13/17). The paper's question is which knockouts change survival under T-cell attack, so the primary contrast is D11+T vs D11 without T cells. Arms of one replicate come from the same infected culture (D11 and D11+T of a replicate correlate most strongly), so replicate is paired (2 residual df). Enriched = KO confers resistance (IRF1, ATF7IP, CASP8); depleted = KO sensitizes (CFLAR, CREBBP, PRMT7). AAVS1 cutting controls and non-targeting guides together form the control set. The CRISPRi screen is design_crispri.json.
